airbnb-checkout-chores-limit.headline: Airbnb stops hosts from requiring guests to strip beds or do other heavy cleaning at checkout.

spotify-family-plan-qr-verification.headline: Spotify is asking Family Plan members to confirm they live together by scanning a QR code.

gemini-android-side-panel-settings-redes.headline: The Gemini app on Android gets a redesigned side panel and settings screen.

apple-ios-27-2-release.headline: Apple releases iOS 27.2 with a new look for Apple Music and Siri AI in five more languages.

gemini-live-plus-menu-attachments.headline: Gemini Live on Android gets a plus button for adding photos and files to a conversation.

instagram-features-long-form-video-test.headline: Instagram is testing Features, a horizontal long-form video format of up to 90 minutes.

apple-ios-27-2-selfie-age-verification.headline: iOS 27.2 adds age verification using a selfie.

apple-macbook-pro-touch-screen.headline: Apple's new MacBook Pro has a touch screen, and Apple has published guidance on designing Mac apps for touch.

vrbo-reserve-now-pay-later.headline: Vrbo launches Reserve Now, Pay Later, with less cancellation flexibility than Airbnb's version.

apple-mac-dynamic-island.headline: The Dynamic Island comes to the Mac, bringing Live Activities to the laptop screen.

chrome-suggested-by-gemini-autofill.headline: Chrome starts filling in much more of a web form with Gemini, under the name Suggested by Gemini.

google-connected-apps-platform.headline: Google opens Gemini and Search to outside apps through a new Connected Apps Platform.

agoda-meta-muse-hotels.headline: Agoda now supplies hotels to Meta's Muse in Singapore and Japan.

tiktok-must-eat-restaurant-guides.headline: TikTok adds Must Eat, a restaurant guide feature.
